description: This file defines a jQuery plugin 'popoverext' that extends Bootstrap's tooltip/popover functionality with additional features such as fixed positioning, custom footer, and dynamic placement. It includes the PopoverExt class with methods for setting content, positioning, and event handling.

classes.name: PopoverExt
classes.description: A class extending Bootstrap's popover to add custom positioning, content, and event handling features.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the popover extension with type, element, and options.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the popover including title, content, and footer.

methods.name: hasContent
methods.description: Checks if the popover has content to display.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets a custom ID for the popover element if specified in options.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the popover with positioning and styling based on options.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Retrieves the footer content for the popover.
